summary: Completed Phase 3 testing of enhanced enterprise ETL platform features. Backend APIs are 75% functional (9/12 tests passed). Frontend UI components for new features (Target Connections, Event Stream, Enhanced Pipelines) are working correctly. Minor issues identified: Schema Matching page authentication, Target tab overlay interception, and missing data-testid attribute.

flaky_endpoints.symptoms: Target created successfully but test endpoint cannot find it
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Target ID might be MongoDB ObjectID instead of UUID

ui_bugs.issue: Target tab click intercepted by dialog overlay
ui_bugs.workaround: Use force=True in Playwright or add proper z-index/pointer-events handling

integration_issues.issue: Page redirects to login, requires re-authentication
integration_issues.note: Session management issue, not a page-specific bug

design_issues.issue: Missing data-testid attribute on main container
